items.title: How the Managed Services Model on AWS Grows Up for Agentic AI
items.summary: Agentic AI introduces new responsibilities for managed services providers on AWS: controlling inference costs, evaluating output quality, and governing agent behavior. Drawing on Avahi’s use of agents in its own operations, this post examines how those responsibilities fit into an existing MSP partnership. Learn what an AI-ready engagement should include and which questions to ask your provider about accountability and measurable business results.
items.creator: Anshu Kapoor
